**In one line**: Global contract research organization ICON announced a multi-year collaboration with Anthropic to bring frontier AI into clinical trials.

### Key points
- ICON is a multinational contract research organization (CRO) that runs clinical trials on behalf of pharma and biotech companies.
- The collaboration is reported to focus on applying Anthropic's frontier AI (the Claude family) to clinical-trial workflows.
- It was announced as a multi-year partnership rather than a one-off engagement.

### Why it matters
Clinical trials are document-, regulation-, and data-heavy, making them a strong candidate for AI-driven time and cost savings. A large CRO signing a long-term deal with a frontier AI provider signals that enterprise AI adoption in healthcare is moving from pilots toward operational use.
